title: Stable effective identity prevents validation-use rebinding

scenario.observed_change: An operation resolves a logical resource once to a stable effective identity, validates authority on that identity, and performs the dependent operation through the same protected identity without re-resolving mutable namespace state.
mutable_state: namespace mapping may change after the stable identity is acquired
authority_boundaries: allowed effective resource identity versus later namespace aliases
operation_model: operate through the same stable identity

required_invariants.requirement: The validated effective target must remain the target actually used by the operation.

must_investigate: whether the operation re-resolves mutable namespace state
whether validation and use share the same stable identity
must_identify: the stable identity preserves validation-to-use binding despite later namespace mutation
must_not_claim: a rebinding defect after evidence establishes that no re-resolution occurs
